respond_to_alert_dialog: respond to a pending alert dialog by accepting it with browser_dialog action accept
dismiss_confirm_dialog: dismiss a pending confirm dialog by clicking cancel with browser_dialog action dismiss
handle_prompt_dialog: respond to a prompt dialog with custom text using browser_dialog action accept and prompt_text
manage_beforeunload_dialog: allow or block a beforeunload navigation by accepting or dismissing the dialog
disambiguate_multiple_dialogs: respond to a specific dialog when multiple dialogs are queued using dialog_id
